name: "Discipline" - Class III

description.content: Decreases the detonation delay of [Shock Therapy] by [0.08s].
Survivors with [Madness] suffer from the [Affliction of Discipline]:

items: [Madness II]: While in a chase, they perceive an illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius as though you were directly behind them. This persists for [6s] after the chase ends.
[Madness III]: The illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius are constantly active.

description.content: You can also see the illusionary Red Stain.

quote: "Respect of our patients is at the core of our principles." -Léry's Memorial Institute
